messages:
Jordan (CS): heads up — customer A and B reporting sudden 502/504s in ap-southeast (hosted). started ~14:02 UTC, spiky for ~8-12 mins, then partial recovery. CS saw lots of client retries and billing auth failures in logs. attaching notes from the support convo.
Anna (oncall): looking now. any correlation with recent deploys?
Jordan (CS): support notes said customers upgraded SDK to v2.1.3 earlier today. we see lots of rapid retries from client. also a few auth refresh errors: "invalid_grant" and 401s from KMS token exchange.
Matt SRE: observability dashboard shows a simultaneous increase in keepalive resets and 5xx rate on the ap-southeast edge pool. p90 latency pushed up right before the 5xx spike. span traces show upstream auth calls timing out ~1s then cascade.
Sanjay - Runtime: can confirm a runtime canary rolled ~13:58 UTC (small config tweak to batching window). deploy-bot: deployment 1876542000 applied to runtime-prod-ap-southeast at 13:58:12 UTC.
deploy-bot: @channel deployment 1876542000 SUCCESS for service runtime-canary-ap-southeast
observability-bot: logs+metrics: https://grafana.internal/r/abcd1234 spike dashboard, correlation view + trace IDs (sampled).
Anna (oncall): mitigation step 1: disable canary routing for ap-southeast and revert batching tweak (rolling-restart to previous version). can someone trigger rollback?
Sanjay - Runtime: initiating rollback now. rolling restart in batches to avoid warmup thundering. ETA ~6m. command: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/runtime-ap-southeast --to-revision=1876540000`
Matt SRE: while rollback runs, enable circuit-breaker at edge to 20% failure threshold and increase idle keepalive to 90s to reduce resets (temp). patching ingress config.
Jordan (CS): customers on the thread got a partial improvement after ~5m, but still seeing client SDK timeouts. recommended they reduce retry concurrency for SDK v2.1.3 until we confirm root cause.
Anna (oncall): status check — rollback completed at 14:08 UTC. 5xx rate dropped to baseline by 14:12 UTC. keepalive resets down as well. tagging for postmortem.
Sanjay - Runtime: confirmed rollback stopped the immediate spike. initial hypothesis: batching window tweak increased KV cache pressure -> higher auth lookups -> timeouts in auth proxy under certain client retry patterns. need deeper trace analysis.
Matt SRE: action items (short): 1) Full trace sampling for ap-southeast for next 48h (owner: Matt). 2) Reproduce with SDK v2.1.3 + high-concurrency retry harness (owner: Jordan+Sanjay). 3) Harden auth proxy timeouts and add backpressure (owner: eng-auth). 4) Add deploy-guard that prevents batching-window change without canary throttling (owner: runtime infra).
Jordan (CS): CS item: update customer comms template and advise SDK retry config change (owner: Jordan).
Anna (oncall): scheduling follow-up sync tomorrow 09:30 UTC to review traces and concrete fixes. assigning postmortem owner: Matt SRE — please file action-tracking doc and commute items to the retro board.
Matt SRE: will do. I'll include logs: sample trace IDs, auth proxy error rates, deployment diff, and a minimal repro harness. prepping a short runbook addendum: immediate mitigation steps (rollback, edge circuit, keepalive)
Sanjay - Runtime: quick repro snippet for the team (please don't run against prod):
```
# repro (local stress against staging runtime proxy)
for i in {1..200}; do 
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $OLD_TOKEN" \
    -d '{"input":"test"}' https://staging-ap-southeast.api.redwood.example/v1/generate &
done
```
We reproduce timeouts when concurrency + small batching window + aggressive client retries combine.
Jordan (CS): adding customer follow-up note: offered temporary throttling and rollback confirmation, customers OK with our timeline.
Anna (oncall): marking thread for postmortem. I'll create the warroom summary and link to the postmortem doc once Matt files it. thanks all for fast reaction :thumbsup:
Matt SRE: filing postmortem doc and action items now — linking when ready.
